objective: Compile a portable Academy skill that turns inspectable domain evidence into a versioned capability-to-mission-to-evidence graph without overstating educational truth.

deliverables.description: An Agent Skills-compatible capability graph architecture package with explicit proof obligations.

context.audience: Academy architects, educators, domain experts, institutions, and learner-owned tool builders

stakes.rationale: Capability graph errors can misroute learning and evaluation, but versioned drafts can be rejected or superseded before release.

must: Separate sourced, derived, and hypothesized graph claims.
Bind every active capability to a mission, artifact, evaluator or rubric, and evidence type.
Keep the complete reference method open and usable without payment.
mustNot: Infer credential status, ownership, reputation, or economic entitlement from graph position.
Publish private learner evidence, raw telemetry, signing material, or hidden evaluations.
Merge or publish a proposed graph without named human approval.

completionTests.value: Each consequential graph claim has provenance or an explicit hypothesis state.
